-p: Sets the port range to scan — wider ranges (e.g. 1-65535) take longer and generate much more traffic
--rate: Sets packets-per-second — higher is faster but more likely to be detected / disrupt the target network
--wait: Delay after all packets are sent before collecting results — higher reduces packet loss but slows the scan
--banners: Connects to open ports to grab real banners — more traffic/footprint than a bare scan
--shard: Splits the scan into parallel shards — the target sees traffic from multiple sessions at once
